Locus coordinate and scale bar annotation

Source: R/annotation-locus-scale.R
annotation_locus_scale.Rd

Adds a scale bar and the window coordinates to a track panel. The bar length is chosen from the visible x-range (a round 1, 2, or 5 x 10^n bp up to 20% of the width), so it adapts to any zoom. With coord_locus() the coordinates show the exact window, e.g. "chr3:187,729,001-187,756,500 (27,500 bp)"; otherwise the visible range is shown without a chromosome. With several windows from coord_loci(), only the scale bar is drawn, and nothing is drawn when the windows have equal widths, as each then has its own scale.

Add to any track, or recreate a standalone scale track with ggplot() + annotation_locus_scale(location = "middle") + coord_locus(win) + theme_void().

Usage

annotation_locus_scale(
  location = c("top", "middle", "bottom"),
  bar_side = c("right", "left"),
  show_coordinates = TRUE,
  colour = "black",
  linewidth = 0.8,
  text_size = 3.4,
  pad = 0.02
)

Arguments

location

Vertical placement in the panel, one of "top", "middle", or "bottom".

bar_side

Side of the panel for the scale bar, "right" or "left". The coordinates are placed on the opposite side.

show_coordinates

Show the window coordinates, default: TRUE

colour

Color of the bar and text.

linewidth

Width of the bar in mm, default: 0.8

text_size

Size of the text in mm, default: 3.4

pad

Distance from the panel edges as a fraction of panel width, default: 0.02

Value

ggplot2 layer

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_bed_track(data = chrom_states, ggplot2::aes(y = sample, fill = segment_label)) +
  annotation_locus_scale() +
  coord_locus("chr3:187734001-187751500", flank = 5000) +
  theme_genomic()
} # }
